rows.grounds: compound of śakti and ucchiṣṭa; object of passive drinking
negative compound indicating absence of alternative
verb describing consequence for those who do not comply
name of a hell as destination

items.question: Why must the remnant of śakti be consumed to avoid Raurava hell?
premises: The remnant of śakti is to be drunk.
Otherwise beings go to Raurava hell.
items.inference: Consuming the remnant of śakti is necessary to prevent falling into Raurava hell.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or doctrinal sense of śaktyucchiṣṭa is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Indeed, the remnant of śakti must be drunk; otherwise, they go to Raurava hell.
